title: Feed the Beast
sub:
Sponsor your local Band.
Though we give everything for you and try to make music the whole time, it is also a matter of cost. There are a few way to support us. Either become a Patron and sponsore us for 5-20.-/ Mo. There are benefits for you as a Patron for e.g. Become more insights in our Band, End of the Month Party/ Gig.

cards.heading: Become a Patron
cards.blurb: Support your local band. Help us play as many gigs as possible. We need support to cover our rent, travel costs, equipment, the photographer, the videographer, etc. If you can spare 5 CHF a month, we’ll play even louder just for you.
